extracted.name: Pitcher Perfect Margaritas
extracted.description: This margarita pitcher recipe uses tequila, triple sec, fresh lime juice, sweetened lime juice, and ice to make the perfect margarita for parties!
instruction_lines: Combine ice, tequila, triple sec, fresh lime juice, and sweetened lime juice in a large pitcher; stir.
Pour kosher salt onto a plate. Rub the rim of a glass with lime wedge. Dip the rim of the glass into salt; fill the glass with margarita mixture; repeat for each serving.
